subject: Pilot acceptance playbook, tests, and go/no-go timeline for MedSpark
messages:
From: Hannah Lowe <hannah@medspark.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@medspark.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot MAP and acceptance tests — kick off

Hi Jonas & Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MedSpark is excited to move into a two-week pilot. Before we kick off we need a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear set of acceptance tests / exit gates so we can align our clinical and engineering stakeholders. Key asks from our side:

- Concrete performance SLOs (latency P95, token cost targets)
- Sample test cases for hallucination / clinical accuracy checks
- Data handling and retention proof points (SOC 2, logs)
- A go / no-go decision date and the list of people who must sign off

Can you send a one-page acceptance playbook + short timeline by early next week so we can route procurement and clinical review? We’d like the initial test run to start the week of Jul 26.

Attachments: none (we'll share a template if helpful).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Lowe
Head of Integrations, MedSpark Health
H: (415) 555-0193

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@medspark.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and acceptance tests — kick off

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear asks. Draft below is our proposed condensed acceptance playbook and timeline. I’m keeping this intentionally tight so it can slot into procurement and your clinical review.

1) Acceptance pillars (must pass all to be "Accepted")
  - Functional correctness: pass-rate >= 95% on 150 blind clinical prompts (see test matrix).
  - Safety / Clinical fidelity: zero critical clinical hallucinations on prioritized scenarios; defined by the clinical team checklist.
  - Latency: P95 generation latency <= 450ms for single-turn prompts; P95 <= 850ms for multi-turn (context up to 1k tokens).
  - Cost baseline: average token-unit cost <= $0.0017 during pilot (with suggested batching).
  - Ops: end-to-end request success rate >= 99.5% and detailed traceability in console logs.

2) Exit gates (stop or rollback if any occur)
  - Critical correctness failure: >2 critical hallucinations in any 50-sample window.
  - Sustained latency breach: P95 > 900ms for 30 consecutive minutes during normal traffic.
  - Security / compliance blocker: inability to provide SOC 2 artifact or audit log access by day 3.

3) Acceptance tests (sample set)
  - Clinical prompt set A (150 prompts) — blind scoring by MedSpark clinicians (pass threshold 95%).
  - Adversarial prompts B (50 prompts) — measure hallucination triggers.
  - Throughput/latency ramp: synthetic traffic at expected 2x pilot concurrency for 1 hour.
  - End-to-end data retention verification: ingest, serve, and confirm deletion flows.

4) Timeline (proposed)
  - Jul 22: Redwood sends MAP v1 + test artifacts (attached: MAP_MedSpark_v1.pdf, pilot-test-cases.csv).
  - Jul 26–30: Pilot execution window (two-week condensed run with daily syncs).
  - Jul 30: Data freeze and scoring complete.
  - Aug 2: Go/no-go decision meeting (stakeholders: MedSpark clinical lead, MedSpark PM, Redwood AE, Redwood CS, Redwood security).

5) Owners & decision authority
  - Redwood: Jonas (technical lead), Karthik (AE).
  - MedSpark: Hannah (integration owner), Alex (clinical lead).

I attached a short MAP + sample test cases. Let me know if any metrics need to shift (e.g., latency SLO). We can also include an explicit rollback procedure if you want it in the MAP.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_MedSpark_v1.pdf (MAP, 2 pages), pilot-test-cases.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@medspark.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and acceptance tests — procurement gating

Hannah, Jonas — quick procurement note to avoid surprises on day 0:

- Procurement needs an executed MSA or a DocuSign envelope pre-authorized by MedSpark procurement prior to start. If you can share PO/approval timelines that helps us schedule onboarding.
- Security wants the SOC 2 summary and evidence that logs/audit playback are available. Attaching SOC2-summary-Redwood-2026.pdf.
- We can provision a private evaluation namespace for you (isolated) but that requires a short security questionnaire (we can complete in 48 hours once you sign the MSA).

If we don’t have the MSA signed by Jul 25, we’ll need to push the pilot start to Jul 29 to preserve two weeks for evaluation and procurement windows.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-summary-Redwood-2026.pdf

From: Hannah Lowe <hannah@medspark.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@medspark.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 11:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and acceptance tests — procurement gating

Thanks — this looks good. Two quick adjustments from clinical: 

1) Latency SLO: clinicians want P95 <= 400ms single-turn (not 450ms). Can Redwood confirm if 400ms is achievable with our expected prompt mix, or propose a mitigated plan (e.g., prioritized caching on key clinical prefixes)?
2) Rollback plan: please add an explicit rollback to a simpler model variant (same API surface) and a timeline for switching (target < 10 minutes to switch traffic).

Procurement note: we’ll fast-track the MSA; I’ll push DocuSign today. If you can attach a DocuSign link here (or a placeholder), I’ll get it moving.

—Hannah

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@medspark.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Finalized MAP, tests, and go/no-go schedule (includes rollback plan)

Team — consolidating the updates and locking the timeline. See attached consolidated MAP and test artifact bundle. Key updates from this thread: 

- Latency: we confirm P95 <= 400ms single-turn is achievable on the pilot hardware with the proposed caching config; we’ll monitor and raise if we hit sustained regressions.
- Rollback: defined two-step rollback — 1) route 20% traffic to model-variant-safe within 60s, 2) full cutover within 8 minutes; runbook attached.
- Procurement: Laura — our DocuSign envelope link is: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/abcd-msa-medsp (placeholder). Hannah — please sign before EOD Jul 27 to keep the original start.

Go/no-go decision meeting: Aug 2 at 14:00 ET (30 min). Meeting owners: Hannah (MedSpark clinical), Alex (MedSpark PM), Jonas, Karthik, Marcus, Laura.

Next steps:
- Jul 27 EOD: DocuSign signed (if not, pilot start moves to Jul 29).
- Jul 26–30: execute pilot (daily 15-min standups).
- Jul 30: scoring complete; Aug 2: decision.

Attachments: MAP_MedSpark_v1.pdf, pilot-test-cases.csv, SOC2-summary-Redwood-2026.pdf, rollback-runbook.pdf, docusign_msa_link.txt

Marcus Lin
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
